questions.prompt: Does a standard `try/catch` block catch normal cmdlet errors (like `Get-Content` on a missing file) by default?

options.a: No — most cmdlet errors are non-terminating; you must add -ErrorAction Stop to make them catchable
options.b: Yes — try/catch automatically intercepts all errors regardless of type
options.c: Yes — but only if $ErrorActionPreference is set to Ignore

questions.prompt: What does the automatic variable `$?` contain after executing a command?

options.a: A boolean indicating whether the last command succeeded (True/False)
options.b: The exit code number of the last process

questions.prompt: When does a `finally` block execute in a `try/catch/finally` statement?

options.a: Always — regardless of whether an error was thrown or caught
options.b: Only when an error occurs and is caught
